alias_map.note: HGNC-verified 2026-10-11: CD20 is prev_symbol of MS4A1 (HGNC:7315); C10ORF54 is prev_symbol of VSIR (HGNC:30085); PVRL4 is prev_symbol of NECTIN4 (HGNC:19688). Canonical symbols retained everywhere; former symbols used only for vocab lookup. Alias applied before lookup; original symbol preserved in unmapped-gene log when neither form matches.

coverage_check.method: exact uppercase symbol match against staged file; full 50-150 universe list pending, re-run check when finalized

derivation.loader: feature_engineering/biological_features/gene_embedding.py::load_gene2vec_txt (space-separated word2vec txt, no header; uppercase/strip; duplicate symbols keep first)

format: word2vec text, no header; one line per gene: SYMBOL + 200 space-separated floats
missing_data_policy: Missing gene -> pair_similarity raises ValueError listing the gene -> feature_builder maps gene_embedding_distance/similarity to NaN per feature_schema (missing = nan). No zero-fill, no mean-fill, no invented vectors. Unmapped genes logged per run; models see NaN (XGBoost nan_to_num(0.0) at train time is recorded in train manifest, not hidden).
normalization: symbols uppercased + whitespace-stripped on load and at lookup; alias_map applied before lookup; duplicates (IGK, NDUFAF4 x2) keep first occurrence

publication.authors: Du J, Jia P, Dai Y, Tao C, Zhao Z, Zhi D
publication.title: Gene2vec: distributed representation of genes based on co-expression
publication.training_data: 984 GEO whole-transcriptome human datasets; 200-dim, iter 9 (grid-search best per paper Table 1)

resource: Gene2Vec pre-trained human gene embeddings (Du et al. 2019)
scope: human genes; staged file: 24,447 rows / 24,445 unique symbols, uniform dim 200 (note: paper text cites 19,307 genes in training corpus; staged Aug-2019 word2vec file contains more rows — reported as-is, not reconciled by invention)
status: validated for DEV-10 (10/10); proxy-21 20/21 with documented CD20->MS4A1 alias; full-universe check pending target list; NO model training performed
